records.name: Absurdist
records.working_definition: Meaning and orderly explanations remain unstable or elusive.
records.mechanic_specification: Track intentional broken expectations and unresolved meaning; distinguish deliberate absurdity from continuity mistakes.

records.name: Action
records.working_definition: Physical conflict and urgent activity carry substantial story weight.
records.mechanic_specification: Track action objectives, geography, cause and effect, preparation, and stunt or animation requirements.

records.name: Action Comedy
records.working_definition: Action and humor jointly shape the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Connect physical set pieces with comic setup and payoff; prevent duplicate action bonuses.

records.name: Adventure
records.working_definition: A journey, discovery, or risky undertaking drives the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Track destinations, obstacles, discoveries, and changing objectives without restricting the setting to historical periods.

records.name: Alternate History
records.working_definition: The story explores a world where history diverged.
records.mechanic_specification: Record the divergence and propagate its consequences through institutions, technology, and character histories.

records.name: Animated
records.working_definition: Movement is created through animation techniques.
records.mechanic_specification: Route to animation production methods rather than assign a narrative genre score.

records.name: Anime
records.working_definition: Animation uses traditions associated with Japanese animation.
records.mechanic_specification: Choose specific visual and storytelling conventions without inferring creator nationality or one universal style.

records.name: Anthology
records.working_definition: Distinct stories share a framing concept or connection.
records.mechanic_specification: Create separate story units and shared links; preserve independent casts and continuity boundaries.

records.name: Apocalyptic
records.working_definition: A civilization-threatening catastrophe is central.
records.mechanic_specification: Define whether catastrophe is approaching, occurring, or recently occurred; track escalation and survival conditions.

records.name: Art House
records.working_definition: A project prioritizes distinctive artistic expression.
records.mechanic_specification: Set formal intentions and audience positioning; do not equate commercial popularity with artistic achievement.

records.name: Avant-Garde
records.working_definition: The work challenges established expressive conventions.
records.mechanic_specification: Support intentional departures in image, sound, narrative, and presentation with explicit creative aims.

records.name: Backstage Musical
records.working_definition: Musical performance and the work of putting on a show drive events.
records.mechanic_specification: Connect rehearsal, performance, and offstage story; derive song, dance, and staging needs.

records.name: Biker
records.working_definition: Motorcycle culture and its participants are central.
records.mechanic_specification: Track motorcycle action and social context; require vehicles and safety support only for scenes that use them.

records.name: Biographical
records.working_definition: The story dramatizes a real person's life.
records.mechanic_specification: Track researched events, invented scenes, chronology, and historical departures separately.

records.name: Black Comedy
records.working_definition: Comedy draws on disturbing, taboo, or painful situations.
records.mechanic_specification: Model intended comic targets, tonal context, and audience response without generic tragedy bonuses.

records.name: Blaxploitation
records.working_definition: The project draws on a historically situated Black-centered exploitation-film tradition.
records.mechanic_specification: Document historical context and selected conventions; avoid translating racial identity into ability or behavior.

records.name: Body Horror
records.working_definition: Bodily transformation or violation is central to the horror.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify transformations, embodiment rules, effects method, and continuity across appearances.

records.name: Buddy Comedy
records.working_definition: A central relationship generates comedy through contrast and cooperation.
records.mechanic_specification: Track the pair's contrasting aims, relationship changes, and shared comic payoffs.

records.name: Buddy Cop
records.working_definition: A policing partnership drives action, investigation, and interpersonal friction.
records.mechanic_specification: Connect partner dynamics to investigative choices and action; avoid counting buddy/action effects twice.

records.name: Caper
records.working_definition: An elaborate scheme or theft is presented with playful complication.
records.mechanic_specification: Track plan, specialist roles, setbacks, and reversals with a lighter tonal intention.

records.name: Chanbara
records.working_definition: Sword combat is a major organizing element of a Japanese period-action story.
records.mechanic_specification: Track combat staging, period setting, choreography, and appropriate research without requiring every scene to fight.

records.name: Chase
records.working_definition: Pursuit structures the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Track pursuer knowledge, route, distance, obstacles, and changing initiative.

records.name: Children's
records.working_definition: The intended audience is children.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify audience age range, clarity, themes, and presentation; do not assume animation.

records.name: Christmas
records.working_definition: Christmas meaning, timing, or traditions shape the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Connect selected traditions and date to character decisions without treating observance as universal.

records.name: Comedy
records.working_definition: Humor is a central intended response.
records.mechanic_specification: Track comic setups, reversals, timing, viewpoint, and payoffs rather than count jokes alone.

records.name: Coming Of Age
records.working_definition: A character undergoes a formative transition toward greater maturity or independence.
records.mechanic_specification: Track starting beliefs, formative choices, relationships, and earned change.

records.name: Concert Film
records.working_definition: A filmed musical performance is the central subject.
records.mechanic_specification: Use setlists, performance coverage, sound capture, audience coverage, and edit continuity.

records.name: Conspiracy Thriller
records.working_definition: Hidden coordinated activity creates danger and uncertainty.
records.mechanic_specification: Track evidence, competing explanations, institutional actors, and what each character knows.

records.name: Cosmic Horror
records.working_definition: Human understanding or significance is challenged by vast unknowable forces.
records.mechanic_specification: Control revelation, uncertainty, and scale; do not require a fully explained monster.

records.name: Costume Drama
records.working_definition: Period setting and its social world are emphasized through dramatic presentation.
records.mechanic_specification: Derive period research and wardrobe requirements from actual scenes and characters.

records.name: Courtroom Drama
records.working_definition: Legal proceedings organize dramatic conflict.
records.mechanic_specification: Track case claims, evidence, witnesses, hearing order, and dramatic stakes using stated procedural assumptions.

records.name: Creature Feature
records.working_definition: A distinctive creature drives threat or fascination.
records.mechanic_specification: Define creature behavior, scale, reveal strategy, and physical or digital realization.

records.name: Crime
records.working_definition: Criminal acts and their consequences organize the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Track motives, acts, evidence, victims, investigation, and consequences without forcing a police protagonist.

records.name: Cyberpunk
records.working_definition: Advanced technology intersects with concentrated power and social marginalization.
records.mechanic_specification: Connect technology access, institutions, identity, and inequality to story choices and production design.

records.name: Dance
records.working_definition: Dance and dancers are central to the project.
records.mechanic_specification: Track choreography, rehearsal, performance coverage, and character meaning in dance sequences.

records.name: Dark Fantasy
records.working_definition: Fantastic elements coexist with dread or disturbing themes.
records.mechanic_specification: Maintain fantasy rules and the intended relationship between wonder and fear.

records.name: Detective
records.working_definition: Solving a mystery through investigation drives the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Track clues, inference, suspect timelines, and the detective's knowledge.

records.name: Disaster
records.working_definition: A large destructive event structures danger and response.
records.mechanic_specification: Track hazard progression, geography, rescue choices, and aftermath; derive effects requirements.

records.name: Docudrama
records.working_definition: Documented events are dramatized with performers.
records.mechanic_specification: Separate sourced events from dramatization and track historically grounded continuity.

records.name: Docufiction
records.working_definition: Documentary material and fictional invention are deliberately combined.
records.mechanic_specification: Mark each sequence's factual or invented basis and preserve disclosure intentions.

records.name: Documentary
records.working_definition: The project makes nonfiction claims about its subject.
records.mechanic_specification: Use research, access, interviews, actuality, evidence, consent records, and an evolving edit structure.

records.name: Domestic Drama
records.working_definition: Household or family relationships are the primary dramatic setting.
records.mechanic_specification: Track relationship obligations, shared spaces, conflict history, and changing alliances.

records.name: Drama
records.working_definition: Character conflict and consequential choices carry the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Track objectives, obstacles, relationships, and earned changes; avoid a generic prestige multiplier.

records.name: Dystopian
records.working_definition: An oppressive or damaging social order shapes life.
records.mechanic_specification: Define institutions, enforcement, everyday consequences, and the possibilities of resistance.

records.name: Eco-Horror
records.working_definition: Environmental damage or ecological forces organize horror.
records.mechanic_specification: Connect the environmental mechanism to the threat, setting, and character decisions.

records.name: Epic
records.working_definition: The story emphasizes large scale, substantial stakes, or broad historical scope.
records.mechanic_specification: Derive cast, locations, time span, and production complexity from the actual outline.

records.name: Erotic Thriller
records.working_definition: Desire, intimacy, and suspense interact.
records.mechanic_specification: Track trust, secrets, power, and boundaries; require appropriate intimacy planning for scripted scenes.

records.name: Espionage
records.working_definition: Intelligence operations and secrecy drive events.
records.mechanic_specification: Track covers, information, handlers, tradecraft assumptions, and exposure consequences.

records.name: Experimental
records.working_definition: The project tests unconventional film forms or storytelling methods.
records.mechanic_specification: Set formal rules and intended experiences; allow non-narrative structure and evaluate consistency with intent.

records.name: Exploitation
records.working_definition: The project foregrounds sensational subject matter or niche market appeal.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify the actual subject, audience promise, and marketing approach; no automatic content or quality assumption.

records.name: Fairy Tale
records.working_definition: A story draws on fairy-tale patterns, transformations, or symbolic logic.
records.mechanic_specification: Track promises, prohibitions, magical rules, and transformations; allow reinterpretation.

records.name: Family
records.working_definition: The project is intended for a broad family audience.
records.mechanic_specification: Define audience range and shared appeal without assuming a child protagonist or animation.

records.name: Fantasy
records.working_definition: Fantastic forces or worlds are integral to events.
records.mechanic_specification: Record world rules, exceptions, costs, and what characters know about them.

records.name: Farce
records.working_definition: Escalating misunderstandings and improbable situations create comedy.
records.mechanic_specification: Track who knows what, entrances, mistaken assumptions, and escalating complications.

records.name: Film Noir
records.working_definition: Crime or moral danger is shaped by noir traditions.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify fatalism, ambiguity, visual approach, and narrative viewpoint without requiring monochrome.

records.name: Folk Horror
records.working_definition: Local traditions, landscape, or community beliefs shape horror.
records.mechanic_specification: Research the chosen context and connect rituals, isolation, and belief to events.

records.name: Found Footage
records.working_definition: The work presents material as recordings made within its world.
records.mechanic_specification: Give recordings an operator, purpose, availability, and plausible survival or recovery path.

records.name: Gangster
records.working_definition: Organized criminal life and its power relations dominate.
records.mechanic_specification: Track organization, loyalty, hierarchy, ambition, and consequences of criminal choices.

records.name: Giallo
records.working_definition: The work draws on Italian thriller traditions combining mystery and stylized menace.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify selected investigative, visual, and suspense conventions; do not impose one mandatory plot.

records.name: Gothic Horror
records.working_definition: Decay, haunting histories, or oppressive spaces generate fear.
records.mechanic_specification: Track setting history, atmosphere, secrets, and how revelations change interpretation.

records.name: Grindhouse
records.working_definition: The project evokes exploitation exhibition aesthetics or traditions.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify texture, presentation, pacing, and audience positioning without lowering technical quality automatically.

records.name: Hangout
records.working_definition: Time spent with characters and their relationships is a major appeal.
records.mechanic_specification: Track social rhythms, recurring spaces, conversation, and incremental change without forcing a large external plot.

records.name: Heist
records.working_definition: Planning and executing a theft structures the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Create target, security, team tasks, dependencies, contingencies, and consequences.

records.name: Historical Drama
records.working_definition: Dramatic action occurs within a researched historical context.
records.mechanic_specification: Maintain period chronology, institutions, technology, and documented versus invented events.

records.name: Historical Fiction
records.working_definition: Invented characters or events inhabit a historical setting.
records.mechanic_specification: Track historical constraints and deliberate departures without demanding a biographical subject.

records.name: Holiday
records.working_definition: A named holiday or observance materially shapes the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Choose specific observances, dates, places, and character participation; no universal cultural behavior.

records.name: Hood Film
records.working_definition: Urban neighborhood life and its social pressures are central.
records.mechanic_specification: Build specific community relationships and conditions; do not make race or neighborhood a crime modifier.

records.name: Horror
records.working_definition: Fear, dread, or disturbing uncertainty is a central intention.
records.mechanic_specification: Define threat, vulnerability, reveal pacing, atmosphere, and consequences.

records.name: Horror Comedy
records.working_definition: Horror and comedy coexist or alternate deliberately.
records.mechanic_specification: Track tonal transitions and which moments aim for fear, humor, or both.

records.name: Isekai
records.working_definition: A character enters or is reborn into another world.
records.mechanic_specification: Track transfer circumstances, retained knowledge, new rules, and identity adaptation.

records.name: Jidaigeki
records.working_definition: A Japanese historical-period setting organizes the work.
records.mechanic_specification: Research the chosen period and institutions; sword action is optional rather than automatic.

records.name: Jukebox Musical
records.working_definition: Existing songs are organized into a dramatic musical work.
records.mechanic_specification: Track song choices, dramatic purpose, performance needs, and music-rights clearance status.

records.name: Kaiju
records.working_definition: Giant creatures are central to spectacle or conflict.
records.mechanic_specification: Track scale, geography, destruction continuity, and the chosen practical/digital technique.

records.name: Kitchen Sink Drama
records.working_definition: Everyday material pressures and social relationships shape intimate drama.
records.mechanic_specification: Track work, household constraints, spaces, and character choices without forcing melodrama.

records.name: Legal Drama
records.working_definition: Legal work or disputes form the main dramatic arena.
records.mechanic_specification: Track participants, arguments, evidence, and procedure assumptions beyond courtroom scenes alone.

records.name: Magical Realism
records.working_definition: Extraordinary elements exist within an otherwise grounded world without constant explanatory separation.
records.mechanic_specification: Set how characters accept the extraordinary and preserve that narrative perspective.

records.name: Martial Arts
records.working_definition: Martial performance and combat traditions are central.
records.mechanic_specification: Track choreography, performer preparation, fighting styles, spatial clarity, and safety.

records.name: Medical Drama
records.working_definition: Healthcare situations and professional/personal choices organize drama.
records.mechanic_specification: Track patient/story continuity, professional roles, research notes, and episode-level cases.

records.name: Melodrama
records.working_definition: Heightened emotion and sharply consequential relationships organize the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Track emotional escalation, reversals, recognition, and relationship stakes.

records.name: Military
records.working_definition: Military institutions and service are central.
records.mechanic_specification: Track ranks, roles, command relationships, duties, and setting-specific equipment.

records.name: Mockumentary
records.working_definition: Fiction adopts documentary presentation conventions.
records.mechanic_specification: Track interview framing, camera awareness, staged evidence, and the intended satirical or dramatic perspective.

records.name: Monster Movie
records.working_definition: A monstrous being drives central conflict.
records.mechanic_specification: Define the being's rules, vulnerabilities, viewpoint, and practical realization; share compatible creature mechanics.

records.name: Mumblecore
records.working_definition: The project draws on intimate, conversational, naturalistic independent-film traditions.
records.mechanic_specification: Support improvisation, small-scale relationships, performance continuity, and conversational scene structure.

records.name: Musical
records.working_definition: Songs or musical performance carry narrative or expressive meaning.
records.mechanic_specification: Track song placement, dramatic function, vocal casting, choreography, recording, and continuity.

records.name: Mystery
records.working_definition: Unanswered questions and their resolution organize attention.
records.mechanic_specification: Track truth, clues, concealment, competing hypotheses, and fair revelation.

records.name: Nature Documentary
records.working_definition: Nonfiction observation of nature is central.
records.mechanic_specification: Track subject access, seasons, observation opportunities, evidence, and narration claims.

records.name: Neo-Noir
records.working_definition: Noir traditions are reworked in later or contemporary contexts.
records.mechanic_specification: Combine noir perspective with a specified social setting and contemporary technique.

records.name: Neorealism
records.working_definition: The work draws on traditions emphasizing everyday life and social conditions.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify locations, casting/performance approach, and observation without a universal style score.

records.name: New Wave
records.working_definition: The work draws on a particular film movement challenging prevailing conventions.
records.mechanic_specification: Require the selected movement/context rather than treating all national new waves as identical.

records.name: Nordic Noir
records.working_definition: Crime storytelling draws on Nordic noir settings or conventions.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify social setting, investigation, tone, and regional research; avoid generic weather-based quality bonuses.

records.name: Occult
records.working_definition: Hidden supernatural practices or knowledge are central.
records.mechanic_specification: Define belief versus reality, ritual rules, investigation, and consequences.

records.name: Parody
records.working_definition: The work imitates recognizable conventions for comic effect.
records.mechanic_specification: Identify the target conventions, transformations, and audience knowledge needed for the joke.

records.name: Period Drama
records.working_definition: The story is set in an earlier era.
records.mechanic_specification: Derive clothing, locations, language choices, props, and social research from the selected time/place.

records.name: Picaresque
records.working_definition: An episodic journey follows a resourceful outsider through social encounters.
records.mechanic_specification: Track encounter sequence, character continuity, and social contrasts without forced three-act structure.

records.name: Police Procedural
records.working_definition: Police investigation and professional methods structure the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Track evidence handling, team roles, investigative sequence, and setting-specific procedure assumptions.

records.name: Political Drama
records.working_definition: Political power, institutions, and personal decisions drive drama.
records.mechanic_specification: Track competing aims, constituencies, alliances, and consequences.

records.name: Political Thriller
records.working_definition: Political conflict is organized around danger and suspense.
records.mechanic_specification: Track threat, information, institutional stakes, and deadline escalation.

records.name: Post-Apocalyptic
records.working_definition: Life after a major catastrophe is central.
records.mechanic_specification: Track elapsed time since disaster, surviving institutions, resources, and world continuity.

records.name: Prison Film
records.working_definition: Confinement and prison relationships organize events.
records.mechanic_specification: Track spaces, access, routines, authority, alliances, and escape or adaptation stakes.

records.name: Psychological Horror
records.working_definition: Fear centers on perception, mental experience, or uncertain reality.
records.mechanic_specification: Track viewpoint reliability and revelations without treating mental illness itself as villainy.

records.name: Psychological Thriller
records.working_definition: Suspense centers on motives, perception, or manipulation.
records.mechanic_specification: Track knowledge, trust, deception, and viewpoint-dependent clues.

records.name: Queer Cinema
records.working_definition: Queer lives, perspectives, or expressive traditions are central.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify individual characters and context; no automatic plot, personality, or market penalty from identity.

records.name: Revenge
records.working_definition: Seeking retaliation organizes the main narrative.
records.mechanic_specification: Track grievance, targets, escalation, moral choices, and the cost of retaliation.

records.name: Road Movie
records.working_definition: Travel along a route organizes encounters and change.
records.mechanic_specification: Track stops, journey time, relationships, and location requirements.

records.name: Rockumentary
records.working_definition: Nonfiction explores rock music, musicians, or their performances.
records.mechanic_specification: Track archival material, interviews, performance coverage, chronology, and music permissions.

records.name: Romance
records.working_definition: A developing romantic relationship is central.
records.mechanic_specification: Track attraction, compatibility, obstacles, choices, intimacy boundaries, and relationship resolution.

records.name: Romantic Comedy
records.working_definition: Romantic development is shaped through comedy.
records.mechanic_specification: Connect relationship obstacles with comic causality and earned emotional payoff.

records.name: Romantic Drama
records.working_definition: Romantic relationships carry substantial dramatic conflict.
records.mechanic_specification: Track relationship decisions, competing needs, and consequences without requiring a happy ending.

records.name: Samurai
records.working_definition: Samurai characters or institutions are central.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify era, social role, obligations, and conflict; combat is scene-dependent.

records.name: Satire
records.working_definition: Humor or exaggeration critiques conduct, institutions, or ideas.
records.mechanic_specification: Define the target, perspective, contradictions, and intended audience interpretation.

records.name: Science Fantasy
records.working_definition: Scientific imagery and fantastic rules coexist.
records.mechanic_specification: Record which rules are technological or fantastic and enforce the chosen boundaries.

records.name: Science Fiction
records.working_definition: Speculative science or technology changes the world or story.
records.mechanic_specification: Define the speculative premise and its coherent personal/social consequences.

records.name: Screwball Comedy
records.working_definition: Fast-paced romantic or social conflict creates comic reversals.
records.mechanic_specification: Track verbal exchanges, status changes, mistaken assumptions, and comic rhythm.

records.name: Sea Adventure
records.working_definition: A maritime journey or undertaking structures adventure.
records.mechanic_specification: Track vessels, routes, weather requirements, practical filming, and character duties.

records.name: Silent Film
records.working_definition: The work uses a predominantly non-spoken-dialogue presentation.
records.mechanic_specification: Plan visual communication, intertitles where chosen, performance, music, and delivery format.

records.name: Slapstick
records.working_definition: Physical actions and mishaps produce comedy.
records.mechanic_specification: Track physical setup/payoff, timing, choreography, and safe production methods.

records.name: Slasher
records.working_definition: A recurring attacker threatens a group in a horror narrative.
records.mechanic_specification: Track attacker access, victim knowledge, spatial continuity, suspense, and aftermath.

records.name: Slice Of Life
records.working_definition: Ordinary experiences and incremental changes organize the work.
records.mechanic_specification: Track routines, small decisions, relationships, and cumulative change without mandatory spectacle.

records.name: Social Realism
records.working_definition: The work foregrounds material and social conditions through grounded representation.
records.mechanic_specification: Tie institutions, labor, environment, and relationships to particular character choices.

records.name: Space Opera
records.working_definition: Large-scale adventure or conflict unfolds across space settings.
records.mechanic_specification: Track factions, worlds, travel rules, spectacle, and effects assets.

records.name: Spaghetti Western
records.working_definition: The work draws on Italian Western traditions.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify moral outlook, pacing, staging, sound, and visual references without forcing nationality.

records.name: Splatter
records.working_definition: Graphic bodily destruction is a central horror presentation choice.
records.mechanic_specification: Track effects design, continuity, practical/digital method, and audience-content settings.

records.name: Sports
records.working_definition: Sport and its participants organize the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Track competition rules, training/performance needs, sporting continuity, and event coverage.

records.name: Spy
records.working_definition: Secret intelligence activity drives the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Use shared espionage mechanics while preserving the user's chosen label and tone.

records.name: Steampunk
records.working_definition: The setting reimagines technology through steam-era aesthetics or assumptions.
records.mechanic_specification: Define technological limits, social setting, costumes, props, and causal consistency.

records.name: Stoner Comedy
records.working_definition: Cannabis-related situations or culture shape comedy.
records.mechanic_specification: Track character choices and comic consequences without universal personality or ability assumptions.

records.name: Superhero
records.working_definition: Extraordinary abilities or heroic identities drive conflict.
records.mechanic_specification: Define powers, limits, identities, collateral effects, and stunt/VFX requirements.

records.name: Supernatural
records.working_definition: Forces beyond ordinary natural explanation affect events.
records.mechanic_specification: Record powers, limits, beliefs, and revelation; does not automatically imply horror.

records.name: Surrealist
records.working_definition: Dreamlike or unconventional associations shape expression.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify visual/narrative logic and intentional discontinuities; preserve production continuity separately.

records.name: Survival
records.working_definition: Characters struggle to remain alive under severe constraints.
records.mechanic_specification: Track threats, resources, environment, decisions, and evolving physical circumstances within the story.

records.name: Swashbuckler
records.working_definition: Flamboyant adventure and physical daring shape the work.
records.mechanic_specification: Track duels, escapes, character objectives, period assets, and stunt choreography.

records.name: Sword And Sandal
records.working_definition: Ancient-world adventure emphasizes heroic action or spectacle.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify historical/fantastic setting, costumes, combat, sets, and crowd needs.

records.name: Sword And Sorcery
records.working_definition: Personal adventure combines martial action and supernatural forces.
records.mechanic_specification: Track quest, combat, magic rules, costs, and creature/effects requirements.

records.name: Techno-Thriller
records.working_definition: Technical systems or capabilities are central to suspense.
records.mechanic_specification: Track system assumptions, evidence, failure chains, and deadline stakes.

records.name: Teen
records.working_definition: Adolescent experiences or an adolescent audience are central.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify whether this describes protagonists, audience, or both; derive casting and scheduling needs separately.

records.name: Thriller
records.working_definition: Anticipation, danger, and escalating uncertainty drive attention.
records.mechanic_specification: Track threats, withheld information, reversals, and consequences of delay.

records.name: Time Travel
records.working_definition: Movement between times is central.
records.mechanic_specification: Define timeline rules, causality, paradox policy, and character knowledge by time period.

records.name: Tokusatsu
records.working_definition: The project draws on Japanese special-effects production traditions.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify suit performance, miniatures, compositing, transformations, and chosen genre rather than equating it with animation.

records.name: Tragedy
records.working_definition: Consequential choices or circumstances lead toward profound loss.
records.mechanic_specification: Track causal progression, turning points, recognition, and the earned ending.

records.name: Tragicomedy
records.working_definition: Comic and tragic experience coexist meaningfully.
records.mechanic_specification: Track tonal balance, transitions, character perspective, and consequences.

records.name: True Crime
records.working_definition: Nonfiction examines actual crimes and their contexts.
records.mechanic_specification: Separate allegations, established facts, evidence, interviews, and unresolved claims.

records.name: Vampire
records.working_definition: Vampiric beings or mythology are central.
records.mechanic_specification: Choose lore, powers, limits, feeding rules, and visual/performance method.

records.name: War
records.working_definition: Armed conflict and its consequences shape events.
records.mechanic_specification: Track factions, objectives, geography, chronology, civilian impact, and scene-derived production needs.

records.name: Werewolf
records.working_definition: Human-to-wolf transformation or related mythology is central.
records.mechanic_specification: Define transformation rules, continuity, identity conflict, and creature realization.

records.name: Western
records.working_definition: Frontier settings or Western traditions organize the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify place/era, land and power conflicts, characters, and scene-derived horses, props, locations, and stunt needs.

records.name: Whodunit
records.working_definition: The central mystery asks which suspect committed an act.
records.mechanic_specification: Maintain culprit truth, means/motive/opportunity, clues, red herrings, and reveal consistency.

records.name: Wuxia
records.working_definition: Martial heroes and a world of chivalric obligations structure the story.
records.mechanic_specification: Track martial conventions, allegiances, codes, choreography, and the chosen degree of fantasy.

records.name: Yakuza
records.working_definition: Japanese organized crime and its relationships are central.
records.mechanic_specification: Specify organization, obligations, era, conflicts, and researched context without identity stereotypes.

records.name: Zombie
records.working_definition: Reanimated or zombie-like beings drive central events.
records.mechanic_specification: Define origin, transmission if any, movement, cognition, vulnerabilities, crowd needs, and continuity.
